The right-hand side of the equation is:
$a_{p+1} + 1 = (p+1+k) + 1 = p+k+2.$
Setting the two sides equal, we get:
$p+3k = p+k+2 \implies 2k = 2 \implies k = 1.$
This means $a_n = n+1$ is a valid solution for all $n$. For this sequence, $a_{2025} = 2025 + 1 = 2026$.
